notes.title: Happy Chinese New Year from "Beat Rider"!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The entire Beat Rider team wishes all players a safe and healthy Chinese New Year! May the Year of the Snake bring you good fortune and happiness!

We’re excited to participate in Steam’s Chinese New Year Sale from January 27 to February 10!

[b]During this event, Beat Rider will be available at a 20% discount! Come and join the adventure![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41753788/e3ccb73402f5f1d3efcdabc91ba0abd8b90e7d4e.png[/img]

If you encounter any issues while playing, feel free to contact us.

ABOUT THE GAME

Beat Rider is an adventure RPG set in a world where humans coexist with the Kuluulu. Humans must maintain a delicate balance with the Kuluulu to preserve their mental and cognitive stability. As a trainee tuner, Mioi embarks on a mission with her companions to rescue those in imbalance in Baixiang City. However, what seemed like a smooth mission soon reveals strange occurrences in the city, with imbalance becoming more widespread and severe. As the tuning files are collected, various storylines begin to unfold...

STEAM PAGE:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1833680/_/

notes.title: BeatRider is out now!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

A huge thank you for your amazing support! 

We’re excited to announce that BeatRider is officially out today! Grab your copy now and enjoy a special 20% launch discount for the first two weeks! Don’t miss out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41753788/0045b8c13f12a208754574b838373c435a256cd7.jpg[/img]

Dive into this exciting role-playing game, meet our talented interns, and confront the disruptive Kururu that throws human emotions and daily life into chaos. Remember, only those with special abilities can see and battle these mysterious creatures. Join us in Baixiang City and embark on a thrilling adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41753788/b7e97ed3d6e6e552aeff85da4b31caeb7a3196f7.jpg[/img]

Thank you once again for being a part of this journey! We can’t wait to see you in the game!

BeatRider team

notes.title: Just 1 day until BeatRider launches!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

BeatRider is launching tomorrow! For the first two weeks, you can enjoy a special 20% discount, making it just $9.60! (Prices may vary by region.)

Here, humans coexist with the Kururu—mysterious creatures that can disrupt mental stability and cognitive abilities of humans. 

Embark on a heroic quest to save those who have lost their mental balance.

As more tasks unfold, things start to get weird—the daily life of Baixiang City has been shattered, with chaos popping up everywhere. As you collect more and more investigation archives, you will dive into this strange and fascinating world alongside the Tuners.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41753788/013d3ed6f8f15248ed0d1ec4516942e6dc3b6f1d.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Add it to your Wishlist now![/b][/h2]

If you run into any problems, don't hesitate to reach out to us on Discord!

BeatRider team

notes.title: 3 days to go! Join BeatRider: save the city from chaos!

notes.title: "Beat Rider" Joins #Anime Game Festival#
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

"Beat Rider" is participating in the #Anime Game Festival# held from August 27th to September 3rd! Additionally, live streaming will be conducted during the event period.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41753788/66cee872ae3207e9e301d808c94555c3ba61a275.jpg[/img]

BeatRider is an adventure role-playing game set in a world where humans coexist with K'lulu. Humans must maintain a benign balance with K'lulu to ensure the stability of their sanity and cognitive abilities. Mioi, as an apprentice Tuner, embarks on a noble mission with companions in Centephonia City to rescue those out of balance. However, as their seemingly smooth mission progresses, the city's daily life starts to exhibit abnormalities, with imbalance phenomena becoming increasingly common and severe. As Tuning files are collected, various story settings will gradually unfold.

We welcome everyone to play and share your experiences with us afterward!

Wishing everyone a pleasant life! Don't forget to add it to your wish list~

notes.title: Steam Next Fest !
notes.content:
[b][h1]Steam Next Fest Demo[/h1][/b]

Beat Rider demo will be available from June 11th to 18th during the Steam Next Fest, and remains accessible in the future. Hope everyone will enjoy it!

The demo version includes three languages: Chinese, Japanese, and English, and will unlock 7 levels, with an estimated duration of about 45 minutes!

The battles of beautiful girls, the secrets of Centephonia City, splendid combos, and perilous missions will take you along with the mysterious Tuners to unveil the world where humans coexist with “Klulu”!

Wishing everyone a happy life! Don't forget to add it to your wishlist~
